notes: «حدثنا أبي» : the compiler's father, a bare relation; «عن جده» : the grandfather of al-Qasim, a bare relation after his name
«سمعت أبا الحسن يقول» : the Imam is the last link, kunya written as the text has it; the compiler's remark on which Imam is meant is left out and the kunya is not identified
